data.name: Misbahah
data.gender_notes: Misbahah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘misbahah’ which means a lamp or source of light and guidance. In Islamic context, Misbahah represents the inner light and guidance from Allah (swt) that illuminates one's path towards righteousness and wisdom. It is also a reference to the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) light and guidance for mankind.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of inner light and divine guidance.
data.etymology: Misbahah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lamp, Guidance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Misbahah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: مصباحه
in_arabic.meaning: مصباحه تعني ضياء و نور و إشراق
in_arabic.long_meaning: مصباحه اسم مؤنث مشتق من المصباح، و هو يعني الضياء و النور و الإشراق. و في القرآن الكريم، يوصف الله تعالى بالنور و الضياء، و من أسماء الله الحسنى النور. و اسم مصباحه يوحي بالهداية و الإضاءة و نور البصيرة.

in_urdu.name: مصباحہ

in_urdu.long_meaning: مصباحہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو مصباح سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے روشنی اور نور۔ یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ نور اور ضياء اللہ تعالیٰ کی صفات ہیں۔ یہ نام لڑکیوں کو دی جاتی ہے تاکہ وہ روشنی اور ہدایت کی علامت بنیں۔

in_hindi.name: मिस्बाहा
in_hindi.meaning: मिस्बाहा का अर्थ है प्रकाश और ज्योति
in_hindi.long_meaning: मिस्बाहा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो मिस्बाह से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रकाश और ज्योति। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि प्रकाश और ज्योति अल्लाह की विशेषताएं हैं। यह नाम लड़कियों को दिया जाता है ताकि वे प्रकाश और मार्गदर्शन का प्रतीक बनें।

in_english.name: Misbahah
in_english.long_meaning: Misbahah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic word 'misbah', meaning light, lantern, or source of illumination. In Islamic tradition, light is considered a divine attribute, and the name Misbahah symbolizes guidance, spiritual enlightenment, and inner radiance. The name Misbahah is often associated with positive qualities such as wisdom, intuition, and spiritual awareness.

It is also common to find Misbahah being used as names for mosques, schools, and charities. Additionally, the name is also used for personal accessories, such as lanterns, candles, and lamps, to represent the spiritual and physical light that guides us.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Misbahah holds immense significance as it represents the inner light of guidance from Allah (swt). This inner light illuminates one's path towards righteousness and wisdom, helping them make the right decisions and live a virtuous life. The name Misbahah also serves as a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge, wisdom, and guidance from Allah (swt) and the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), just as a lamp provides light to a dark room. It is a call to stay on the path of truth and avoid the darkness of ignorance and misguidance.
